usage: Use 彩色 to mean “colourful” or “in colour,” usually for things with many colours. 例句：呢張海報好彩色。
It often comes before a noun to describe the thing. 例句：我買咗一支彩色筆。
You can also use 彩色 for photos, screens, or printing that are not black and white. 例句：部相機影出嚟係彩色嘅。
In daily Cantonese, 彩色 sounds natural for bright, colourful objects and images. 例句：小朋友鍾意彩色氣球。
